summary: An agentic terminal harness: a native macOS app and a browser Workbench are clients of a per-user Rust daemon (axod) that owns PTYs, Pi agent processes and the session catalog; a Cloudflare Worker relays remote clients to linked hosts.
coverage: First pass; see coverage/ for the files reviewed. Daemon (axo-server, axo-pty, axo-pi, axo-ipc, axo-relay, axo-protocol), API Worker and pi-axo read in depth; Mac app and web app read at the level of their RPC usage only.
